fields.title: Senior Software Developer
fields.description: We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Developer to join our IT team. You will be responsible for designing and developing scalable web applications using modern technologies.
fields.requirements:
• 5+ years of experience in software development
  • Proficiency in Python, Django, and React
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure)

fields.title: HR Business Partner
fields.description: Join our HR team as a Business Partner. You will work closely with department heads to implement HR strategies and support employee development.
fields.requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in HR or related field
  • 3+ years of HR experience
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Knowledge of employment laws

fields.title: Financial Analyst
fields.description: We are seeking a Financial Analyst to support our finance team with budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting.
fields.requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Finance or Accounting
  • 2+ years of financial analysis experience
  • Proficiency in Excel and financial modeling
  • Strong analytical skills

fields.title: Operations Manager
fields.description: Lead our operations team and ensure smooth day-to-day business operations. Manage logistics, vendor relationships, and process improvements.
fields.requirements:
• 5+ years of operations management experience
  • Strong leadership and organizational skills
  • Experience with process optimization
  • Bachelor's degree in Business or related field

fields.title: Junior Frontend Developer
fields.description: Entry-level position for a Junior Frontend Developer. Great opportunity to learn and grow with our development team.
fields.requirements:
• 1-2 years of frontend development experience
  • Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript
  • Familiarity with React or Vue.js
  • Strong willingness to learn
